descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Build, patch, play together in VR

**PatchWorld** is a live spatial creative sandbox where music, art, logic, physics and play come together. Build anything from a simple toy or instrument to an interactive game, machine, audiovisual performance or entire world.

[media]

Inspired by modular synthesisers and visual programming, PatchWorld lets you connect more than **230 blocks** for sound, visuals, logic, physics, movement and interaction directly in 3D space. **Patching is programming made physical:** connect blocks, change what they do, and see the result instantly while everything keeps running.

[media]

Explore **500+ devices** and more than **3,000 published community worlds**, open creations to understand how they work, remix them, or build your own from scratch.

- **Create together:** build and play with others in multiplayer.
- **Connect your setup:** MIDI, OSC, Ableton Link and WebBridge.
- **PatchSound:** proprietary real-time spatial audio for instruments, immersive sound and live performance.
- **Make it yours:** import sounds, images, 3D assets and custom avatars, with optional AI tools for generating content.

[media]

**Build something. Patch it together. See what happens.**

Join our Discord for community support, and learn through our Wiki and workshops.
